result.instructions: Tools for Octadesk, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show the open tickets that are assigned to me and are older than three days."; "What happened in ticket 1024? Show the conversation in order."; "Find the requester with the e-mail anna@example.com and list her tickets.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Octadesk data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run octadesk_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run octadesk_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run octadesk_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. octadesk_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: octadesk_search_tickets
tools.title: Search tickets
tools.description: Search tickets with optional filters. Returns the page of tickets plus paging fields (total_count, search_id, next_page_url). For the next page, pass the same filters with the returned search_id and page + 1. GET /tickets/search.

status.description: Status: novo, pendente, resolvido, andamento, rejeitado or cancelado.

type.description: Type: problema, nao-especificado, tarefa, duvida or incidente.

content.description: Free text found in the ticket.

sort_by.description: Sort field, for example number, done_date or last_date_update.

search_id.description: search_id from an earlier reply, to read the next page.

tools.name: octadesk_get_ticket
tools.title: Get ticket
tools.description: Get one ticket by its number, with its fields and status. GET /tickets/{number}.

tools.name: octadesk_get_ticket_interactions
tools.title: Get ticket conversation
tools.description: List the interactions of one ticket: replies, internal notes and property changes, in order. GET /tickets/{number}/interactions.

tools.name: octadesk_list_requester_tickets
tools.title: List tickets of a requester
tools.description: List the tickets of one requester. Pass last_number to read past the last ticket of the previous page. GET /tickets.

last_number.description: Number of the last ticket returned by the previous page.

tools.name: octadesk_list_custom_ticket_lists
tools.title: List custom ticket lists
tools.description: List the saved custom ticket lists (views) of the account. GET /tickets/custom-lists.

tools.name: octadesk_find_person_by_email
tools.title: Find person by e-mail
tools.description: Find one person (requester or agent) by exact e-mail address. GET /persons?email=.

tools.name: octadesk_get_person
tools.title: Get person
tools.description: Get one person by id. GET /persons/{id}.

tools.name: octadesk_search_requesters
tools.title: Search requesters
tools.description: Search requesters (customers who open tickets) by e-mail or name. GET /persons/requesters.

keyword.description: Text to match against the e-mail or the name.

tools.name: octadesk_search_agents
tools.title: Search agents
tools.description: Search agents (staff who work tickets) by e-mail or name. GET /persons/agents.

keyword.description: Text to match against the e-mail or the name.

tools.name: octadesk_create_ticket
tools.title: Create ticket
tools.description: Create a ticket. Common keys of `ticket`: summary, requester ({ email, name } or { id }), idGroupAssigned, idAssigned, idPriority, idCurrentStatus, idSubject, tags (string array), comments ({ internal: { content } } for an agent-only note, { public: { content } } for a reply the requester can read). POST /tickets.

ticket.description: Ticket fields. Send only the fields you set.

tools.name: octadesk_update_ticket
tools.title: Update ticket
tools.description: Change fields of one ticket, for example status, priority, assignee or group. Send only the fields to change. A `comments.public` entry is e-mailed to the requester. PUT /tickets/{number}.

tools.name: octadesk_create_person
tools.title: Create person
tools.description: Create a person (requester or agent). Send the person fields, for example email and name. POST /persons.

person.description: Person fields, for example email, name and organization.

tools.name: octadesk_update_person
tools.title: Update person
tools.description: Change fields of one person. Send only the fields to change. PATCH /persons/{id}.

prompts.title: Get started with Octadesk
